==Notes==
* Be careful not to over-[[aggro]]; the area he's in is swarmed with many different types of creatures, including two other groups with bosses. The group Mhedi travels with is also rather large, which makes it a challenge to get the [[Signet of Capture|skill capture]].

==Trivia==
* This boss is named after Mehdi Mousavi, a member of the Guild Wars Localization team.
